test_title: PYST 6: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

When I was eight years old, I __used to played__ with toys.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4' **i.e. **'used to play'.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the underlined segment** 'used to played'** is incorrect because **'used to' **is **always followed **by the base form of the verb, not the past tense. 

Therefore, the **corrected sentence** would be: *"When I was eight years old, I **used to play **with toys."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Use to played.' **is incorrect as it changes the tense and also keeps the incorrect past form 'played' after 'use to'.
 
• **'Used to playing.'** is not suitable here because 'used to' is followed by the base form of the verb, not the -ing form.
